name: Vegetable oil (not specified)
explanation: The label says only that the oil is vegetable and does not name it. In India the unnamed oil is very often palm, but the packet does not say so, and this entry records that the answer is unknown rather than guessing either way.

sources.note: Alias wordings observed in the ingredient statements of imported Indian products.
Written by Prana contributors. Describes what the substance is; contains no health claim and no value copied from a label.

aliases.note: Each alias was seen in at least one imported product.

flags.note: Ambiguity recorded as ambiguity. Not a claim that palm is present.
